Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task with a description, due date, frequency, and completion status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

dueDate.description: The date when the task is due.

frequency.description: The frequency of the task (daily, weekly, monthly).

completed.description: Indicates whether the task is completed or not.

definition.description: Stores task data for each user. Path-based ownership ensures that only the user can access their tasks.

firestore.reasoning: The data structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and secure data access for the TaskTrack Budget app. It leverages path-based ownership for tasks, storing them under the respective user's document. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, facilitating atomic operations and easy debugging. The structure also supports secure `list` operations by isolating each user's tasks within their own collection.  Tasks are stored as documents within a user-specific subcollection (`/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}`). This ensures that only the user can access their own tasks. No denormalization is needed as ownership is implicit in the path.
